title: Collection List Changed Webhook
description: Webhook notification sent when a collection list's resolved collections change. Contains a summary only — recipients must call get_collection_list to retrieve the updated collections. Deliveries use the AdCP RFC 9421 webhook profile unless the receiver registration explicitly selects a legacy 3.x authentication mode.

idempotency_key.description: Sender-generated key stable across retries of the same webhook event. Governance agents MUST generate a cryptographically random value (UUID v4 recommended) per distinct list-change event and reuse the same key on every retry. Recipients MUST dedupe by this key, scoped to the authenticated sender identity established by the RFC 9421 signing key or explicitly configured legacy authentication — keys from different governance agents are independent.

list_id.description: ID of the collection list that changed

change_summary.description: Summary of changes to the resolved list

collections_added.description: Number of collections added since last resolution

collections_removed.description: Number of collections removed since last resolution

total_collections.description: Total collections in the resolved list

cache_valid_until.description: When the consumer should refresh from the governance agent

signature.description: Deprecated 3.x compatibility field. This value is not an authentication input: RFC 9421 signatures are carried in the Signature and Signature-Input HTTP headers and bind the payload through Content-Digest. Receivers MUST ignore this body value when authenticating a delivery. New senders MUST omit it; the field is removed in 4.0.
